- "USC" (Ultra-Supercritical) technology is not yet operational in Vietnam; all commissioned coal units are Subcritical or Supercritical.

| Project Official Sites | Individual TPP feasibility/EIA & commissioning reports | `https://www.[plantname].vn` (e.g., `nghi-son.evn.vn`, `phumy.evn.vn`) |

## Usage Notes
- **Status definitions** align with MOIT/EVN classifications: *Operational* (commercially generating), *Under construction* (civil/mechanical work active), *Suspended* (paused pending policy/grid/funding review), *Cancelled* (formally removed from PDP8 Amendment), *Planned* (feasibility/EIA stage, COD >2025), *Retired* (decommissioned).
- **Technology mapping**: Coal units are classified as Subcritical (<16 MPa/540°C) or Supercritical (≥24 MPa/566°C). No USC units are operational in Vietnam as of 2024. Gas units use CCGT (combined cycle) or OCGT (open cycle) configurations.
- **Capacity note**: Only units >30 MWe are included. Older 110 MW coal units are retained for historical completeness but noted as upgraded/retired where applicable.
- For real-time tracking, consult the **MOIT Power Development Plan Amendment**, **EVN Generation Company (TPPC) annual reports**, and **National Load Dispatch Center (NLDC)** grid data.
